# SEP-EC-untrimmed — per-event manifest

`rows_shipped` are byte-identical to the distributed SEP-EC files. `rows_pre` /`rows_post`
are restored background before onset / after the catalog end (`is_reconstructed` = 1 / 2).
`post_raw_backed_pct` is the share of post-event rows backed by a genuine flux datum.
`era = 2012-blackout` marks events whose flux was recovered by inverting the derived
datasets — faithful, but not independent measurements.
